title: Pachchak Kuthira
desc: A man, living in slums, is infamous for annoying people and is unaware that the people hate him. However, as he finally realises this he wholeheartedly decides to transform himself.

title: kaathale Nimmathi
desc: Kavitha is to be married to Chandramohan. However, things take a turn when her brother suspects that she is having an affair with Chandru, an archaeologist, when in fact they are strangers.

title: Chandramouli
desc: When a family is forced to leave a village on the Sri Lankan coast, a mother gets separated from her son. He fights against all odds, including his evil stepbrother, to meet his mother.

title: Veettoda Mappillai
desc: While Kandasamy's two sons-in-law are useless and unemployed, Manikkam, his third son-in-law, helps him improve his hotel business. However, the return of Kandasamy's son causes trouble.

title: Seethanam
desc: After being released from jail, Muthu Manikkam takes on the illegal activities of a corrupt politician to settle old scores. But he faces trouble through a lawyer who does not approve of his deeds.
